items.name: Whole mandarin/tangerine orange (unpeeled; edible flesh only counted)

scale_cues: Square white plate about 26–27 cm wide, roughly 360 px across. The fruit is about 120 px across, which works out to about 7.5–9 cm. Because the photo is taken from above, the top of the fruit is closer to the camera and looks a little bigger, so I adjusted the size down slightly.
assumptions: The fruit is a mandarin or tangerine, or possibly a small navel orange. The bumpy, loose-looking peel and its size point to a mandarin.
I estimate the whole fruit with peel at about 160–170 g. Grams count only the edible flesh, with about 25% removed for peel and pith.
Calories are about 51 kcal and 0.8 g protein per 100 g of mandarin flesh. An orange would be about 47 kcal per 100 g.
The pink and red smears on the plate are leftover residue from an earlier dish, not food, so they are not counted.
No sauce, oil or drink is visible.
